answer: Quadratic staking at the saffron gate: n sybil identities each lock n× the base stake, so a farm of 100 wallets posts 10,000× one honest stake. A zero-knowledge thread binds each identity to its deposit via a commitment, so fresh wallets cannot recycle the same capital. The falcon verifier sweeps all clones in one batch, converting 100 deposits into 100 bonded commitments. Break-even: an attacker needs revenue above n² stake, so at n=100 the cost is 10,000× honest entry and returns go negative fast.
